final.title: Final Submission
final.description: Upload your {{count}} final prompts for official evaluation. This submission will be used for the final competition ranking.
final.howItWorksDesc1: The final submission is the last phase of the competition. You must upload exactly {{count}} prompts that will be evaluated to determine the final ranking.
final.howItWorksDesc2: Unlike the playground, final prompts will be evaluated by all available models and scores will be combined for a more accurate and comprehensive assessment.
final.howItWorksDesc3: File format: Upload a plain text file where each line contains a single prompt.
final.checklistPromptCount: Make sure you have exactly {{count}} prompts in the file.
final.checklistLanguage: Verify that all prompts are in Italian.
final.checklistDuplicates: Check that there are no duplicate or too similar prompts.
final.checklistReview: Review the best prompts tested in the playground.
final.warningOnce: The final submission can only be made once.
final.warningNoEdit: You will not be able to modify the prompts after submission.
final.warningTeamAgree: Make sure all team members agree before proceeding.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Upload your prompts every day to test and improve before the final submission. Get preliminary evaluations and discover more effective prompts.
playground.howItWorksDesc1: You can upload up to 25 prompts per day to get preliminary evaluations that help you test different strategies before the official submission.
playground.howItWorksDesc2: Each prompt receives a provisional score from a single language model. In the final submission, prompts will be evaluated by different models and combined for a more accurate assessment.
playground.howItWorksDesc3: File format: Upload a plain text file where each line contains a single prompt.
playground.tipReadInstructions: Read all instructions carefully before proceeding.
playground.tipDuplicates: Prompts identical to those already submitted will be discarded.
playground.tipOneUpload: You can only upload once per day per team.
playground.tipCultural: Try different Italian cultural aspects and safety topics.
